title: assessment.criterion.finalized v1
description: DAT-010. One finalized official decision on one marking point, produced by assessment-service GET /integration/events (X-Integration-Key) and consumed by planning-service. Only rule, checker and teacher decisions are emitted - never a generative model's. eventId = UUIDv5(eventIdNamespace, sourceEntityId + '#' + sourceVersion), so ids are stable across reads and any version's id can be derived. Consumers dedupe on event_id and, per source_entity_id, keep only the highest source_version (a teacher correction supersedes; an older version arriving later is stale). Additive fields may appear within major version 1; consumers ignore unknown fields and reject any other major version.

subject_user_id.description: The student's Supabase user id from the linked account - never a client-supplied value.

source_version.description: 0 = deterministic rule/checker decision; n = the n-th teacher decision on the point.

source_topic_codes.description: Assessment topic codes (e.g. U03_5). The consumer maps them only through reviewed aliases in topic-registry.v1.json; anything else is quarantined.

assessed_at.description: When the student answered (attempt submitted, else marked).

occurred_at.description: When this decision became final (marking or latest teacher review).
